mainEntity.name: What time does New Power Muay Thai start on 30 September 2026?

acceptedAnswer.text: The event starts at 18:00 Bangkok time. Doors open at 17:00.

mainEntity.name: How many rounds are the fights?

acceptedAnswer.text: New Power follows the traditional five-round Muay Thai format.
New Power normally features eight or nine bouts. The confirmed number for 30 September should be taken from the verified event information.

mainEntity.name: Can I arrive after the event has started?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The stadium gates remain open during the evening.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to print my ticket?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The QR ticket can be shown on your phone when entering the stadium.

mainEntity.name: How will I receive my ticket?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your Stripe receipt confirms payment. Your New Power event tickets are then prepared and sent separately by MuayTix by email.

mainEntity.name: Is New Power a three-round event?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. New Power uses traditional five-round Muay Thai.

mainEntity.name: Is New Power suitable for someone new to Muay Thai?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The five-round format gives a first-time visitor time to see how rhythm, tactics and momentum develop as each fight progresses.
